2119588838028796220.en_summary: I doubt Jensen Huang will be able to remain as $NVDA CEO. This could put short-term pressure on the stock of the second most valuable company in the world. He has no natural successor within the company. While Huang has not committed any crime or tort, his code of conduct and judgment will be called into question which will likely result in his removal by the NVDA Board. While I don’t see long-term value impairment, many portfolio managers will reduce their $NVDA holdings in the coming weeks as a result of uncertainty over who could succeed Jensen as NVDA CEO. Includes board statement and Huang’s apology email regarding personal matter and support for investigation into national security concerns.
2119588838028796220.zh_summary: 我懷疑黃仁勳能否繼續擔任 $NVDA 執行長。這可能對全球第二大市值公司的股票造成短期壓力。他在公司內沒有自然接班人。雖然黃仁勳沒有犯下任何罪行或侵權，但他的行為準則和判斷力將受到質疑，這很可能導致 NVDA 董事會將他免職。雖然我認為長期價值不會受損，但許多投資組合經理將在未來數週因接班人不明確而減少其 $NVDA 持倉。包含董事會聲明及黃仁勳關於私人事務的道歉信，並支持對國家安全疑慮的調查。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 短期壓力，接班人不明，長期價值無損
